reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: p0033 gives successive twelve-month (not multi-year) renewals with a thirty-day Customer non-renewal notice window and a sixty-day Vendor reminder, and p0034 caps uplift at the lesser of trailing-12-month CPI-U and three percent with ninety days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods — all four parameters meet the preferred position.

The failed deterministic check ('number not found') is explained by the instrument spelling numerals in words ('thirty days', 'twelve-month', 'sixty days', 'three percent'); the regex is a phrasing-variant miss, not a substantive gap.
No redline or comment is expected for a compliant finding, and none was proposed; paragraphs are returned unchanged, so there is no directional or over-editing risk.
Rationale correctly scopes out adjacent concerns (Section 2.1 take-or-pay commitment) to other rules and correctly declines to flag the Customer-only non-renewal asymmetry, which favours our side.
